description.text: The eleventh expansion of the XY series, released on 3 August 2016 with 116 cards, two of them secret rares beyond its 114. It brought back dual-type Pokémon, last seen in HS—Triumphant, with eight new ones, and has the Mythical Pokémon Volcanion and Magearna, the first Pokémon from Alola in the card game. Its six new Pokémon-EX include Shiny Mega Gardevoir-EX, and its seven Pokémon BREAK include Xerneas BREAK and Yveltal BREAK.

sources.title: Wikipedia: List of Pokémon Trading Card Game sets

League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month; each came with a sealed kit of twelve of these cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division.
